# Circulation glossary

Maintained by the Circulation department since 2012. When a term changes, update it here first; staff training and the OPAC help pages copy from this page.

Each entry has a definition, the other names staff use, and whether CIRC implements it.

## Patron

**Def.** A person registered with the library who holds a library card.
**Aliases:** cardholder, member, user
**Status:** implemented

## Library Card

**Def.** The barcoded card that identifies a patron at the desk and the kiosks.
**Aliases:** card
**Status:** implemented

## Branch

**Def.** A library building, or the bookmobile, where items are shelved and loans are made.
**Status:** implemented

## Title

**Def.** A bibliographic record: one work in one edition, as the catalogue describes it.
**Aliases:** bib record, work
**Status:** implemented

## Item

**Def.** One physical copy of a title, identified by the barcode on its spine label.
**Aliases:** copy, piece
**Status:** implemented

## Loan

**Def.** One item lent to one patron, from checkout until check-in.
**Aliases:** circ, charge
**Status:** implemented

## Checkout

**Def.** Lending an item to a patron at the desk or a kiosk, and setting its due date.
**Aliases:** charge, issue
**Status:** implemented

## Checkin

**Def.** Receiving a returned item, closing its loan and assessing any fine.
**Aliases:** return, discharge
**Status:** implemented

## Renewal

**Def.** Extending a loan by one more loan period without bringing the item in.
**Status:** implemented

## Loan Period

**Def.** How long an item may be kept, set by its format.
**Aliases:** loan length
**Status:** implemented

## Borrowing Limit

**Def.** The most items a patron may have out at once, set by patron type.
**Status:** implemented

## Patron Block

**Def.** A patron who owes $10.00 or more, or whose card has expired, cannot borrow.
**Aliases:** blocked card
**Status:** implemented

## Hold

**Def.** A patron's request for the next available copy of a title.
**Aliases:** reserve, request
**Status:** implemented

## Hold Trapping

**Def.** Setting aside a returned copy for the oldest waiting hold on its title.
**Aliases:** trap, capture
**Status:** implemented

## Hold Expiry

**Def.** A trapped hold not picked up within seven days lapses and the copy goes to the next patron.
**Status:** implemented

## Fine

**Def.** Money a patron owes the library for one loan.
**Aliases:** charge, fee
**Status:** implemented

## Fine Assessment

**Def.** Working out what a patron owes for an overdue loan: daily rate by format after the grace period.
**Status:** implemented

## Grace Period

**Def.** Days after the due date during which no fine accrues.
**Status:** implemented

## Fine Cap

**Def.** A fine for one item never exceeds the item's replacement cost or $20.00, whichever is lower.
**Aliases:** maximum fine
**Status:** implemented

## Overdue Notification

**Def.** Telling a patron, by email or a printed letter, that items are overdue.
**Aliases:** overdue notice, courtesy notice
**Status:** implemented

## Lost Item

**Def.** An item the patron has declared lost, or that is 60 days overdue; the patron is billed its replacement cost.
**Status:** implemented

## Self-Checkout

**Def.** A patron checks out or renews their own items at a kiosk.
**Aliases:** kiosk checkout, self-check
**Status:** implemented

## Interlibrary Loan

**Def.** Borrowing a title Riverbend does not own from another library for one patron.
**Aliases:** ILL
**Status:** implemented; retiring 30 June 2027 (Prairie Libraries Consortium takes over)

## Turnover Rate

**Def.** Loans per item per year, by branch and format; the collection manager's measure of use.
**Aliases:** circulation per item
**Status:** planned for the 2027 annual report

## Digital Lending

**Def.** Lending e-books and e-audiobooks through the library's vendor account.
**Aliases:** e-lending, OverDrive
**Status:** not implemented (patrons use the vendor's app)

## Claims Returned

**Def.** A patron says they returned an item the record shows as still out; staff search the shelves before billing.
**Status:** not implemented (tracked on paper at the desk)

# Retired terms

Older names that still appear in reports, forms and the database.

### Borrower

**Def.** The pre-2016 name for a patron.
**Aliases:** borrower class
**Status:** deprecated in 2016 (CIRC-412); use Patron
